# Svelte by LuKaria — llms.txt

> Svelte by LuKaria is Jamaica's premier physician-supervised virtual weight loss clinic, specialising in GLP-1 medications including Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) and Semaglutide (Ozempic/Wegovy). Founded and led by Dr. Kadria Fairclough (BSc, BMedSci, MBBS, LMCC), the clinic delivers telehealth consultations and medication delivery island-wide across Jamaica.

## About

- **Clinic name**: Svelte by LuKaria
- **Website**: https://www.lukariagroup.com
- **Founder & Physician**: Dr. Kadria Fairclough — BSc, BMedSci, MBBS, LMCC — 15+ years of clinical experience, specialising in obesity medicine and lifestyle medicine
- **Service model**: 100% virtual (telehealth) — no waiting rooms, medication delivered to patients
- **Location served**: Island-wide Jamaica
- **Languages**: English
- **Contact**: svelte@lukariagroup.com | +1 (876) 290-3659
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/18762903659
- **Book a free consultation**: https://calendly.com/kadriaf-lukariagroup/weight-loss-consultation

## Services

- Physician-supervised GLP-1 weight loss programs
- Tirzepatide (brand: Mounjaro) — once-weekly injection for chronic weight management
- Semaglutide (brands: Ozempic, Wegovy) — once-weekly injection for chronic weight management
- Virtual physician appointments (monthly)
- Personalised treatment plans
- Free medication delivery across Jamaica
- Ongoing health monitoring and patient support
- Referral discount program

## Clinical Facts (sourced from published trials)

- Tirzepatide users lost an average of **22.5% of body weight** in clinical trials (SURMOUNT-1, NEJM 2022)
- Semaglutide users lost an average of **up to 20% of body weight** in clinical trials (STEP-1, NEJM 2021)
- Both medications are administered as once-weekly subcutaneous injections
- Common side effects: nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, vomiting (typically transient, reduce with dose titration)
- Medications are prescription-only and require physician evaluation before starting

## Competitive Differentiators

- Only physician-led GLP-1 virtual clinic serving all of Jamaica
- Flat monthly fee — price does not increase with dose escalation
- Free medication delivery islandwide
- Canadian-trained physician with Telehealth experience (LMCC credentialed)
- No waiting rooms, no pharmacy queues — everything handled virtually
